summary: Junior web developer who builds web applications with Laravel, PHP and MySQL, and responsive front ends with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap. I enjoy turning ideas into clean, user-friendly products, from online shops to admin dashboards.

projects.title: Myanmar Handicrafts System
projects.description: A Laravel shop for Myanmar handicrafts. Customers browse, order and pay by KPay, Wave or cash on delivery, and admins manage stock and orders.
features: Cart with stock check, checkout and payment slip upload
Admin dashboard with low-stock alerts and restocking
Order accept/decline with email to the customer
projects.imageAlt: Homepage of the Myanmar Handicrafts System showing the Myanmar Traditional Handicrafts banner

projects.title: Online Book Shop
projects.description: A Laravel bookshop where customers browse books, fill a cart and check out, and the owner manages books, authors, categories and orders.
features: Book catalog with detail pages and a cart
Checkout that saves orders with their line items
Owner admin panel with role-based access
projects.imageAlt: Stack of web design and UX books

projects.title: Rosiva Flower Shop
projects.description: A Laravel flower shop with a catalog you can browse by category and occasion, a cart, and an admin dashboard for products and images.
features: Browse flowers by category and occasion
Cart with quantities, saved in the browser
Admin dashboard with CRUD and image uploads

projects.title: Gym Management Admin Panel
projects.description: A Laravel admin panel for a gym to manage members, classes, staff users and role-based permissions.
features: Member records with profile photo upload
Class scheduling with status and photos
Roles and permissions with Spatie Permission
projects.imageAlt: Gym floor with treadmills and weights
